fix(theme): adapt all pages to dark mode using shadcn colorScheme

Replace hardcoded AppColors.surface/textSecondary/textPrimary/divider
with theme-aware ShadTheme.of(context).colorScheme equivalents:
- AppColors.surface → scheme.muted
- AppColors.textSecondary → scheme.mutedForeground
- AppColors.divider → scheme.border
- AppColors.textPrimary → scheme.foreground
- Toolbar/card Colors.white → scheme.card

Affected pages: home, templates, device_search, device_manage,
device_settings, history, history_detail, profile, about, user_guide,
graffiti, label_editor, rich_editor, print_preview, ocr,
and all coming-soon stub pages.

Canvas drawing areas (graffiti, label_editor, print_preview) keep
Colors.white intentionally — print paper is always white.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
